mapper.insert: INSERT INTO delegated_token (token_hash, account_id, scope, expires_at) VALUES (#{tokenHash}, #{accountId}, #{scope}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL #{ttlSeconds} SECOND)
mapper.select: SELECT account_id FROM delegated_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND scope = #{scope} AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM delegated_token WHERE expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(request, '$.payload.name')) AS name, MAX(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(request, '$.payload.takenAt') AS UNSIGNED)) AS last_taken_at, COUNT(*) AS times_recorded FROM action_ledger WHERE account_id = #{account} AND tool = 'record_medication' AND status = 'DONE' AND created_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL #{days} DAY GROUP BY name ORDER BY last_taken_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
